create_seggpt_config: create a SegGptConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
build_seggpt_model: build a SegGptModel using a SegGptConfig instance initialized with default or custom parameters
validate_seggpt_architecture: validate SegGptConfig architecture by checking merge_index against intermediate_hidden_state_indices
configure_seggpt_mlp_dim: configure SegGptConfig mlp_dim to override the default hidden_size times 4 calculation
summarize_seggpt_config: summarize the SegGptConfig fields including hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, image_size, and decoder settings
